rationale.quality-debt: Quantifies recurring non-security API defects in LLM-generated Python and Java code.
rationale.ai-review: Dr.Fix uses LLM judgments to detect, classify, reason about, and repair misuses.
rationale.framework: Dr.Fix defines a reusable staged detect-reason-fix repair architecture.
rationale.built-system: Authors implement and benchmark Dr.Fix across three repair models.
rationale.assistive: Study targets IDE completion and infilling at method and parameter granularity.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports functional API-quality failures and evaluates their mitigation.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled completion tasks characterize three third-party code-generation models.
